تختطفين (form VIII)
# تَخْتَطِفِينَ (taḵtaṭifīna) /tax.ta.tˤi.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# تُخْتَطَفِينَ (tuḵtaṭafīna) /tux.ta.tˤa.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
